claims.text: Patty Murray (D-WA) is listed as Vice Chair of the Senate Appropriations Committee on the committee's official members page, which is the ranking minority position on that committee.
Susan Collins (R-ME) is listed as Chair of the Senate Appropriations Committee on the committee's official members page.

edges.label: seat 4 of 12 - Vice Chair (ranking minority member), Senate Appropriations
edges.note: The Senate Appropriations Committee styles its ranking minority member 'Vice Chair'. The title does not change the 119(e)(2) entitlement.

edges.label: seat 3 of 12 - Chair, Senate Appropriations
edges.note: Held two of the twelve seats simultaneously in the 118th Congress as ranking member of both the full committee and its Defense Subcommittee.
